---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new capability
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What pain or limitation are you running into today? Be specific about the
workflow and the role(s) affected.

## Desired outcome

What would you like to happen instead? Sketch the UX, the data model change,
or the new behavior.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why they don't quite fit.

## Scope hints (optional)

- Does this affect planning, history, Gantt, or settings?
- Does this need new permissions or new server-side endpoints?
- Does this need to be configurable per project, or universal?

## Additional context

Screenshots, links to similar features in other tools, or links to related
issues.
